summary: Add pinned shared M36/M666/M1296 interoperability fixture and repository-local conformance tests.
rationale: Pin one immutable cross-repository conformance fixture to the M36 Root blob and enforce exact independent root schema/content version propagation through consumer and runtime registry envelopes.
verification: A shared fixture records the canonical M36 Root blob SHA and both M36 version domains.
CI validates the fixture structure before running the repository test suite.
M666 and M1296 registry envelopes carry exact root_schema_version and root_genome_version values.
No Root Genome mutation, package release, credential change, or Production deployment is included.
